definitions.gloss: to check against; to compare; to cross-reference
definitions.explanation: To compare one thing with another to verify accuracy, consistency, or correspondence. Often used when checking data, documents, or information against a reference.

examples.japanese: ⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check it against the list.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原本|げんぽん}→原本：15697_genpon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせて⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked it against the original to make sure there were no errors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正|ただ}しくない→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: When I checked it against the regulations, I found that this procedure was not correct.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{照|て}らす→照らす：04669_terasu⟧ (to shine, to illuminate) and ⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ (to put together). The image is of holding two things up to the light to compare them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{原本|げんぽん}→原本：15697_genpon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる (to check against the original)
- ⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる (to compare against a standard)
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる (to check against the facts)
- ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる (to cross-reference with records)

Often used in formal or business contexts. The particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ marks the reference item being compared against.
